mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.parent_id AS "parentId", d.name, d.ancestors, d.sort, d.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.dept_id = d.id AND u.deleted = FALSE) AS "userCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dept c WHERE c.parent_id = d.id) AS "childCount" FROM sys_dept d ORDER BY d.sort, d.id
SELECT ancestors FROM sys_dept WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dept(parent_id, name, ancestors, sort, status) VALUES(#{parentId}, #{name}, #{ancestors}, #{sort}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), parent_id = #{parentId}, ancestors = #{ancestors}, sort = COALESCE(#{sort}, sort), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dept WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
